cycle1_swift_existing_setup.description: Prepare a stored five-point Swift Recovery fixture and a blank Wizard hat for the preserved-config reforge card
commands: replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.0 ebwizardry:wizard_hat 1 0 {Quality:{Name:"Swift Recovery Stored 5",Color:"aqua",Slots:["head"],AttributeModifiers:[{AttributeName:"jawmsintegrations.mana_regen_delay_reduction_percent",Name:"qualitytools",Amount:5.0d,Operation:0,UUIDMost:510L,UUIDLeast:510L}]}}

cycle1_swift_existing_stored_observe.description: Capture raw held-item NBT for the stored five-point fixture under the preserved configuration

cycle1_swift_existing_reforge_observe.description: Capture raw held-item NBT for the Swift Recovery result reforged from the preserved five-point configuration

cycle1_swift_default_setup.description: Prepare the same stored fixture and a blank Wizard hat after fresh Swift Recovery default generation
commands: replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.0 ebwizardry:wizard_hat 1 0 {Quality:{Name:"Swift Recovery Stored 5",Color:"aqua",Slots:["head"],AttributeModifiers:[{AttributeName:"jawmsintegrations.mana_regen_delay_reduction_percent",Name:"qualitytools",Amount:5.0d,Operation:0,UUIDMost:510L,UUIDLeast:510L}]}}

cycle1_swift_default_stored_observe.description: Capture raw held-item NBT proving the stored five-point fixture remains unchanged after fresh default generation

cycle1_swift_default_reforge_observe.description: Capture raw held-item NBT for the Swift Recovery result reforged from the fresh ten-point default

cycle1_swift_cleanup.description: Remove Swift Recovery validation fixtures and close the diagnostic session
